description:
Stuck on your latest project? Don't know how to get from one scene to the next? Today's quick tip aims to equip you with a focus on creative transitions!

If you want to dig deeper into each one of the transitions, check out the full article on School of Motion. Article link here: https://bit.ly/SOM-Transitions
